title: Former Oregon interim police chief fired after criticising city leaders wins $935,000 in retaliation case
summary_full: Sean Lundry, who formerly held the position of interim police chief in Oregon, has been awarded $935,000 by a federal jury. The verdict recognized that city officials penalized him for exercising his First Amendment rights, particularly after he raised concerns about the police chief recruitment process in January 2024. His criticisms included issues related to public records and alleged financial misconduct by the city.
